value.behaviour: Omit default or invalid arrowheadSize on restored elements and normalize currentItemArrowheadSize in restoreAppState.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE and isValidArrowheadSize from @excalidraw/common.

2. In restoreElementWithProperties generic constraints, exclude "arrowheadSize" alongside "customData" from Required<ExcalidrawElement> and Required<T> in K, and allow optional arrowheadSize?: ExcalidrawLinearElement["arrowheadSize"] on T and extra.

3. In restoreElementWithProperties before returning ret, if ("arrowheadSize" in ret && (!isLinearElement(ret) || !isValidArrowheadSize(ret.arrowheadSize) || ret.arrowheadSize === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE)), delete ret.arrowheadSize.

4. In restoreAppState return object, normalize currentItemArrowheadSize: isValidArrowheadSize(nextAppState.currentItemArrowheadSize) ? nextAppState.currentItemArrowheadSize : defaultAppState.currentItemArrowheadSize.

sites.rule: Allow optional arrowheadSize in restoreElementWithProperties type parameters T, K, and extra.

value.behaviour: Register actionChangeArrowheadSize and render it inside actionChangeArrowProperties next to changeArrowhead.
rules: 1. Import ARROWHEAD_SIZES, DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE, and type ArrowheadSize from @excalidraw/common.
2. Export const actionChangeArrowheadSize = register<ArrowheadSize>({ name: "changeArrowheadSize", label: "labels.arrowheadSize", trackEvent: false, perform, PanelComponent }).

3. In perform(elements, appState, value, app), call invariant(value, "actionChangeArrowheadSize: value must be defined"), update selected linear elements where canHaveArrowheads(el.type) via newElementWith(el, { arrowheadSize: value === DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE ? undefined : value }) followed by updateElbowArrowRoute for elbow arrows, update appState.currentItemArrowheadSize to value, and return captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY.

4. In PanelComponent, render a fieldset with legend {t("labels.arrowheadSize")} and RadioSelection<ArrowheadSize> (group="arrowhead-size", options for ARROWHEAD_SIZES.sm/md/lg/xl with FontSizeSmallIcon/FontSizeMediumIcon/FontSizeLargeIcon/FontSizeExtraLargeIcon, labels.small/medium/large/veryLarge, and testIds arrowheadSize-small/arrowheadSize-medium/arrowheadSize-large/arrowheadSize-veryLarge), using getFormValue with (element) => (isLinearElement(element) && canHaveArrowheads(element.type) ? element.arrowheadSize ?? DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE : null), predicate (element) => isLinearElement(element) && canHaveArrowheads(element.type), and default (hasSelection) => (hasSelection ? null : appState.currentItemArrowheadSize || DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE).
5. In actionChangeArrowProperties PanelComponent, render {renderAction("changeArrowheadSize")} between {renderAction("changeArrowhead")} and {renderAction("changeArrowType")}.
